IP is the standard abbreviation for Internet Protocol and is retained in Vietnamese.
ID is the standard abbreviation for an identifier and is retained in Vietnamese.
# is the language-independent number-sign symbol.
OCR is the standard abbreviation for optical character recognition; the ellipsis indicates that the action opens a dialog.
URL is the standard abbreviation for Uniform Resource Locator and is retained in Vietnamese.
Alpha is the established graphics parameter name for transparency or opacity.
HH:MM:SS.FFF is the language-independent hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds format pattern.
Teletext is the established name of the broadcast text and subtitle service.

Tab is the keyboard-key label used here for the tab-character field separator.
VobSub is the subtitle-format name, and sub/idx are its associated file extensions.
